from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9f087961.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    bars = []
    for row in grid:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row):
            if row[i] == background:
                i += 1
                continue
            color = row[i]
            while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
                i += 1
            bars.append(color)
    bars.sort(reverse=True)
    bars = (bars + [0] * 6)[:6]
    return [bars[:3], bars[3:]]
'''
p.write_text(source)
